description: Tuples of the same length don't unify when an element is bool in one and number in the other
notes: The spec's rules only say that number and bool each unify with string, and none names bool with number. But it defines unification as finding a type that all the given types can be converted to, the most general supertype in a lattice, and bool and number both convert safely to string, which would give the tuple ["true", "x"]. hashicorp/hcl fails to unify element 0, and then fails the whole unification (unifyTupleTypes in cty/convert/unify.go) instead of trying a list of all the element types, which would be a list of strings.
